{{Quote|Mandalorians are what you'd call a loose association of clans. Aliens, humans, bounty hunters, mercenaries. But we all got one thing in common. We fight to be strong. We fight for honor and glory. The bigger, smarter, faster the enemy, the better.|Vort Norman|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Vort Norman''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] living on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When the Mandalorian [[Deth Kregg]] issued a personal challenge, Norman carried word of it to [[Outpost Tempest]] near [[Kaas City]] and maintained a pool of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to be claimed by the one who defeated Kregg.<ref name="TOR" />
